title: Quadratic-Phase Fourier--Bessel Transform: definitions, properties and uncertainty principles
summary: In this manuscript, we introduce the quadratic--phase Fourier--Bessel transform and develop its foundational properties, including continuity, the Riemann--Lebesgue lemma, reversibility, and Parseval's identity. We define the associated translation operator and convolution product, establishing their main properties within this framework. As an application, we prove a Donoho-Stark-type uncertainty principle for the quadratic-phase Fourier--Bessel transform, extending classical uncertainty results to this generalized setting.
